full_name: IEEE/ASME International Conference on Advanced Intelligent Mechatronics
organizer: IEEE Robotics and Automation Society (RAS), IEEE Industrial Electronics Society (IES), ASME Dynamic Systems and Control Division (DSCD); flagship conference of IEEE/ASME Transactions on Mechatronics (TMECH)

submission.type: full paper (contributed/invited papers); also TMECH/AIM Focused Section (journal + conference) and late-breaking results
submission.typical_abstract_deadline: Late January to late March (2026: Mar 24; 2027: Jan 26)
submission.typical_final_deadline: Early May to early June (2026: Jun 1; 2027: May 3)
submission.notes: No separate abstract stage. 'abstract_deadline' holds the 'Contributed/Invited Papers & TMECH Presentation Only' deadline from the official site. AIM 2027 key dates (official aim2027.com): TMECH/AIM Focused Section Dec 23, 2026; invited/workshop/special session proposals Jan 21, 2027; contributed/invited papers Jan 26, 2027; TMECH/AIM first decision Feb 22, 2027; final decision Apr 23, 2027; final paper May 3, 2027; late-breaking May 9, 2027.

editions.notes: Cross-checked 2026-10-16: abstract_deadline filled 2022-03-11 (contributed papers, official aim2022.org Important Dates).

Cross-checked 2026-10-16: start/end changed 2023-06-28/2023-06-30 -> 2023-06-27/2023-07-01 per official aim2023.org ('June 27-July 1 (Tue-Sat), 2023'); technical sessions ran June 28-30 per the official Program at a Glance. Cross-checked 2026-10-16: abstract_deadline filled 2023-02-10 (contributed papers, extended from Feb 1, official aim2023.org).

notes: Next edition AIM 2027, Calgary, Canada, June 29-July 2, 2027 (official aim2027.com; venue 'coming soon'). Deadline conflict: official site lists contributed/invited papers due 2027-01-26, while the IEEE RAS event calendar lists a paper submission deadline of 2027-03-02 (used official value; verify). IEEE IES calendar lists Calgary but July 12-15, 2027 (outlier). The Georgia Tech AIM history page lists AIM 2027 as Boulder, CO, July 12-16 - appears outdated; superseded by the official site. Georgia Tech page also lists AIM 2022 as 'Hakodate' but SICE/proceedings records say Sapporo (Sapporo used); it also lists AIM 2026 as July 7-11 vs official July 7-10 (official used). AIM 2023: CFP says June 28-30; welcome message/MDPI list June 27-July 1 (incl. tutorials). AIM 2024: PaperCept pages vary between July 15-18 and 15-19. AIM 2020 dates from Georgia Tech page (July 6-10). Paper deadlines for 2015-2025 not verified (null); an aggregator mention of 2020-01-08 for AIM 2020 was not confirmed. Edition dates 2015-2021 rely on the Georgia Tech AIM history page (aimrl.gatech.edu) because dblp was blocked.
